note: Three default repeated attempts use the same full original-coordinate scan/map and saved actual ICP result, not independent drive frames or recorded SLAM telemetry. The CSV fixture only dispatches/ranks attempts. Real file loading, cloud/normal copies, ranking/report assembly, NN preparation/search/statistics/thresholds and scoped cleanup are timed. Registration solving, parity tracing, snapshot preparation/checks/hashing, artifact/color/PLY work and CLI writes are excluded. Pages are warmed; cold ingestion and RSS are not measured. A traced parity pair, excluded first pair and two warm-up pairs precede alternating timed pairs. All observations remain. The control already prepares once per attempt; the current path shares map loading/preprocessing and an uncropped reference across attempts, retaining private registration targets. No entire ICP/SLAM-run, cropped/downsampled-workload or GPU speed claim.
